# Compiler regression fixture

`qiskit_uc_regression.npz` contains sixteen 2×2 unitary matrices generated by
`scripts/audit_compiler_failure.py`, from the n=10 hierarchical seed-13 target,
random tree seed 2026, and 3× local truncation tolerance. They are the input to
one failing UCGate inside the third emitted isometry (64×4).

The frozen numerical fixture isolates synthesis from SVD/LAPACK variation.
`tests/test_compiler_regression.py` checks an independent dense-unitary oracle
and explicitly marks the two upstream reproductions as expected failures.
Strict XPASS makes a backend change visible and requires revisiting the test.
The fixture is not a circuit label or a proposed production fix.
